methods.name: CreateLayout
methods.description: Create a vertical or horizontal layout inside an existing App Inventor arrangement. Use width/height -1 for Fill Parent and -2 for Automatic.

methods.name: CreateChildLayout
methods.description: Create a nested vertical or horizontal layout inside another layout ID.

methods.name: AddText
methods.description: Add a text label to a layout ID. textSize is in scaled pixels; width/height use pixels, -1 Fill Parent, -2 Automatic.

methods.name: AddButton
methods.description: Add a clickable button to a layout ID. A ComponentClicked event is raised with its ID and type=button.

methods.name: SetText
methods.description: Change the text of an existing label or button by ID.

methods.name: SetTextColor
methods.description: Change the text color of an existing label or button by ID.

methods.name: SetBackground
methods.description: Change the background color and corner radius of an existing component by ID.

methods.name: SetSize
methods.description: Set a component's width and height in pixels. Use -1 for Fill Parent and -2 for Automatic.

methods.name: SetVisible
methods.description: Set a component visible or hidden by ID.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Set a component's enabled state by ID.

methods.name: SetTextSize
methods.description: Change the text size of a label or button. Size is in scaled pixels (sp).

methods.name: SetAlpha
methods.description: Set a component's alpha from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).

methods.name: SetClickable
methods.description: Set whether a component can receive clicks.

methods.name: SetButtonColors
methods.description: Change a button's text and background colors.

methods.name: SetOrientation
methods.description: Set a layout's orientation to horizontal or vertical.

methods.name: GetChildCount
methods.description: Get the number of direct children inside a dynamic layout.

methods.name: SetPadding
methods.description: Set padding in dp for a layout ID.

methods.name: SetSpacing
methods.description: Set the spacing between children in a layout ID, in dp.

methods.name: Fade
methods.description: Fade a component in or out over durationMs milliseconds.

methods.name: Slide
methods.description: Slide a component up into view or down out of view over durationMs milliseconds.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Remove one component or an entire nested layout and all of its descendants by ID.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Remove every component created by this extension. The original App Inventor arrangement remains.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Check whether a component ID currently exists.

methods.name: GetText
methods.description: Get the current text of a label or button by ID.

name: TaskComponents
helpString: Create and manage customizable native Android layouts, labels, and buttons by unique ID.

events.name: ComponentClicked
events.description: Raised when a dynamic button is clicked. Returns the component ID and its type. Kept for compatibility.

events.name: ComponentClickedWithText
events.description: Raised when a dynamic button is clicked. Returns its unique ID, type, and current displayed text.

events.name: ComponentLongClicked
events.description: Raised when a dynamic button is long-pressed. Returns its unique ID, type, and current displayed text.
